SciFact oracle-document sentence ranking, training evidence only. Union all annotated sentence indices per claim/document. Assign documents with integer SHA256(decimal doc ID) modulo 3 equal to zero to selection, remaining documents to evaluation. Exclude selection pairs whose claim ID occurs in evaluation. Rank ties by ascending sentence index. Primary metric is macro pair reciprocal rank of first labeled sentence. Secondary metric is pair recall@3. Fit lexical statistics independently on each document's individual sentences. Compare sklearn unigram/bigram English-stopword TF-IDF cosine (author-like lexical proxy), positive-IDF BM25 (k1=1.2,b=.75, lowercase word tokens), and the same TF-IDF with center score plus weight times mean available immediate neighbor scores. Select weight from .25,.5,1 by selection MRR, lowest on tie. Bootstrap evaluation documents jointly with replacement 5000 times (seed 42), retaining all pairs and reporting percentile 95% intervals on paired MRR differences. No dev/test access. Descriptive within-training evidence localization only.
